card.name: Just before a city name appears
card.fires_on: Small words or marks right before a city name is expected, such as 'at' or 'in' after an institution or event, or a comma after a conference or publisher. Also the start of a city in a parenthetical affiliation.

modes.label: Place link words
modes.description: 'in' or 'at' after an institution, event or venue, where a city follows.

modes.label: Citation comma
modes.description: A comma after a publication, conference or publisher name, before the city.
modes.example: Proceedings of the twenty-third International Conference on Information Systems<<,>> Barcelona, Spain.

modes.label: Reference punctuation
modes.description: Link starts or colons in reference lists where a place or name follows.

card.writes: It promotes city names such as London, Paris and Tokyo, so it predicts that a city comes next.
card.plain: It fires at the point in a sentence or citation where the name of a city is about to be given.
